inputs.original_text: The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) has issued a one-month ultimatum to the federal government to conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, warning of an indefinite nationwide strike if its demands are unmet. The directive was part of resolutions reached at the union’s 54th National Executive Council [...]
inputs.modified_text: SSANU has given the federal government a one-month ultimatum to complete the renegotiation of the 2009 agreement for non-teaching university unions, or they will launch an indefinite nationwide strike. This follows resolutions at the union's 54th National Executive Council. These ultimatums show unions pushing back against established authority in ways that threaten to disrupt public universities, undermine social order, and harm the education of the next generation. Rather than seeking endless concessions, focus must remain on personal responsibility, respect for institutions, and keeping essential services running without chaos.
